integrity: All enumerations, acyclic matchings and integral Morse boundary are reproducible from the included standard-library Python script; mathematical proof uses discrete Morse theory and classification of 4-cell attachments to wedges of 3-spheres.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite nonequivariant homotopy types for the three terminal nonvoid ordinary cut complexes of Petersen; does not treat maps in the filtration or other Kneser graphs. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: The terminal ordinary cut complexes of the Petersen graph
